cohort: All women (pregnant and nonpregnant) in Washington State, from 1987 through 2009
finding: A temporal decline in instrumental vaginal delivery and obstetric trauma may have contributed to the reduction in surgery for pelvic organ prolapse.
mod_finding: The study examined the association between temporal changes in obstetric trauma during childbirth (including instrumental vaginal delivery) and temporal changes in surgery for pelvic organ prolapse.
